item.title: [7.9] Indian bonds tumble on oil surge, RBI rate hike fears
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds experienced a decline as the benchmark yield exceeded 7.45% on Thursday. The Reserve Bank of India has raised its repo rate to 5.50%, indicating a potential for further hikes.

WHY IT MATTERS

The combination of surging oil prices, breaching key yield thresholds, and aggressive RBI rate hikes represents a material macro shift for emerging market debt and inflation tracking.
